append.x_authority_gate_schema: [HOSTINGER-V20-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION-v1.2-CANDIDATE] The executor reads an attributable CHG and bounded D007 release from authoritative services and verifies scope, target identity, tree identity, validity, state and the non-Claude assessment. Caller-supplied strings, local matching hashes, design-only CHGs, catalogue status, chat approvals and builder self-assurance are not authority. A direct Steward decision is recorded by id and still needs its CHG/D007 effect release.
append.x_deterministic_tech_requirements: [HOSTINGER-V20-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION-v1.2-CANDIDATE] (1) Source is a Git-pinned commit reproducible from baseline plus patch, with static dependency and migration checks. (2) Every reader of a pinned source verifies raw received bytes before decoding; a transformed copy never redefines a pinned digest; every SHA-256 routine passes the length-boundary conformance test. (3) Transfer may use any QUALIFIED route; success is the destination verifier returning MATCH_ALL, not the transport exit status. The verifier is read-only and fail-closed, runs INSIDE the Odoo container over the addons_path Odoo is configured to load (first-match resolution, duplicates refused), cross-checks the host mount, refuses every symlink (file, directory, dangling, addon root, path entry), special files, unexpected directories, and any receipt location inside or reaching an examined tree (checked before anything is read or written, on every path including refusals); it never records passwords. A P0 result counts as full verification only when the in-container and host-mount views both match; a container-only result is a distinct, non-passing class. (4) A read-only P0 prestate receipt (addon-tree match to baseline, database.uuid, image id, compose hash, DB facts) precedes any write. (5) Installation requires a consistent DB+filestore recovery pair, a throwaway restore, a rehearsed upgrade with injected failure, one RUN_LOCK holder. A VM-wide backup is not a rollback for one addon.
append.x_execution_input_contract: [HOSTINGER-V20-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION-v1.2-CANDIDATE] Release input binds, by value: Work Object and state revision/hash; Git commit and per-addon release manifest sha256; verifier and prestate-script sha256; target identity (host, container image id, database name, database.uuid taken from the P0 receipt); the scoped CHG id and D007 effect-release id; recorded Steward decisions; the non-Claude D009 assessment of the same commit; recovery-pair ids; RUN_LOCK id; invocation id and idempotency key (sha256 over the preceding bindings) with an expiry. A file format, archive or transfer method is never a release identity.
append.x_execution_outcome_schema: [HOSTINGER-V20-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION-v1.2-CANDIDATE] Return per stage: status in NOT_RUN | PASSED | FAILED | HELD with an error-class code from ERROR_CLASS_REGISTRY; p0 receipt (verdict and sha256), staging receipt, rehearsal log hashes, install log hashes, post-install readback. Never label an untested stage PASSED. Report registry maturity as passed/total error classes and list every NOT_RUN class.
append.x_execution_profile_requirements: [HOSTINGER-V20-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION-v1.2-CANDIDATE] Stage progression: source -> transfer -> prestate -> rehearsal -> authority -> install -> accept/recover, each with exact release id and truthful state. A later stage starts when its own prerequisites hold; post-install acceptance is never a prerequisite for starting an authorised install. After two failures in the same transport class, change the failure mechanism or the qualified route rather than repeat. Independent source work continues while a protected effect is held.
append.x_observation_learning_contract: [HOSTINGER-V20-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION-v1.2-CANDIDATE] Anti-fragility loop: every failure or near-miss yields (1) the failure mechanism, (2) a regression test that reproduces the original failure, (3) a control proving that test can fail, (4) a versioned append to this contract, (5) a recurrence check in the next comparable cycle. Measure recurrence, time-to-detect and NOT_RUN count. No claim of improvement without a second comparable cycle.
append.x_provider_fallback_policy: [HOSTINGER-V20-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION-v1.2-CANDIDATE] Select the transport from OBSERVED capability, not assumption. Qualified today: the Steward/D007 console route. SSH/rsync from an AI runtime and Hostinger-API compose delivery are UNINSTALLED until qualified; each needs the same identity, rights, destination verification and negative tests. A missing qualified route is HOLD, not a reason to weaken a check.
append.x_return_acceptance_schema: [HOSTINGER-V20-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION-v1.2-CANDIDATE] Reject a result lacking: destination MATCH_ALL receipt for the frozen manifest; P0 receipt MATCH_ALL with a non-empty database.uuid; recovery proof; the D009 assessment of the same commit; the D007 effect release; or reporting any NOT_RUN error class as passed.
